description:
Great digital marketing doesn't come from simply filling a calendar. It comes from understanding what stops the scroll, keeps people watching and brings audiences back. As Content and Social Media Manager at The Avenue, you'll have the freedom to create, test and learn while helping shape the online presence of a growing property brand and its network of partner agents.

This is a hands-on opportunity where you'll be responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering our day-to-day activity across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. What's in it for you
- £30,000 to £35,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid and field-based working across the West Midlands.
- Genuine ownership of The Avenue's day-to-day channels and creative direction.
- Freedom to experiment with new formats, platform features, creative concepts and emerging technology.

- A culture built around TEST LEARN ADAPT SCALE, where new ideas are encouraged and every test is an opportunity to learn.

- Manage and execute the social media strategy across key platforms, ensuring consistent, engaging and relevant activity.
- Own the publishing calendar, schedule and day-to-day activity across key platforms.
- Create and edit Reels, TikToks, Stories, Shorts and other content, developing strong concepts, hooks and formats.
- Test different edits, Trial Reels, platform features and creative approaches, using results to decide what to develop further.
- Plan seasonal, reactive and behind-the-scenes property material, working with videographers and other creatives where higher-production support is needed.

- Experience interpreting social analytics and turning performance data into clear ideas and recommendations.
- Strong copywriting skills and an understanding of how content should adapt across different platforms and audiences.

title: Volunteer Co-ordinator

description:
About the Role

We are looking for an organised, detailed-oriented individual, to support the Volunteer and Training Manager in a co-ordinator role, to further expand and enhance, the volunteer department.

This role will be to work closely with the Volunteer and Training Manager, in a co-ordinator capacity, whilst also using your own skills and initiative to work more independently, assisting the department to grow and develop. Your responsibilities will include co-ordinating volunteer recruitment and training logistics, ensure smooth onboarding processes, building and maintaining relationships with partners and stakeholders, and maintain accurate records.

This is a varied role that requires strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Investment in staff is important to us, and additional training and support will be provided throughout.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities
- Provide day to day administrative support to the Volunteer and Training Manager
- Maintain accurate and well-organised electronic systems for volunteer records; monitor applications on the volunteer management system (Volgistics), keeping up to date with relevant changes/additions
- Shortlisting candidates for volunteering roles and completing informal meetings
- Complete all pre-boarding checks for new volunteers, and monitor progress throughout their volunteer journey
- Update and maintain spreadsheets, records and databases with volunteer information, and compile basic reports on request
- Monitor and respond to emails and queries sent to shared volunteering inboxes, referring or escalating as appropriate
- Ensure confidentiality and accuracy when handling sensitive volunteer information; remaining GDPR compliant at all times
- Attending volunteer meetings, capturing key discussions and decisions and then distribute the minutes
- Understand and respond to managers requests for new volunteers
- Co-ordinate with and assist mentors, with the development of volunteers
- Liaise with, and continue to build on, relationships with voluntary service councils across the West Midlands, to place new volunteer roles and remain up to date with relevant changes
- Attend external events for recruiting volunteers
- Liaise with higher education institutions and advise on their requests for student placements; from assisting with shortlisting through to onboarding
- Provide support with room bookings, refreshments and setting up for training or volunteer events
- Research relevant training for each department, supporting with the booking and smooth facilitation of these

Person Specification

Essential Criteria
- Strong written English skills
- At least 2 years' experience in recruitment, onboarding and people management Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in their work
- Proficient organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
- Clear and professional verbal communication
- An understanding of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook
- Experience with maintaining electronic records, and familiarity with database systems
- A proactive and flexible approach to work, with a willingness to support colleagues as needed
- Ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team
- A friendly and approachable manner, with a commitment to providing a helpful and supportive service

Desirable Criteria
- Experience working in a multicultural setting with sensitivity to different cultures.
- Ability to work independently and self-motivate.
- Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to empathise while maintaining professional boundaries.
